objects.description: [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) has exploited misconfigurations in GitHub Actions and vulnerabilities such as CVE-2026-33634 in the Aqua Security Trivy scanner and CVE-2025-55182 (React2Shell) against vulnerable cloud endpoints.(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: Aikido TeamPCP Telnyx MAR 2026)(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026)(Citation: Wiz Mini Shai-Hulud MAY 2026)
